text_block_list.text:
Christmas, with the Arima Kinen right 
around the corner—

Since early morning, I had been 
researching the differences between how 
Christmas is celebrated in Japan versus 
the US.
choice_data_list:
(There are quite a lot of differences, 
huh...)

text_block_list.text:
Since we had the opportunity, I had 
planned to spend an American-style 
Christmas and refresh our spirits before 
the showdown with Symboli Kris S, but—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Pardon me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Merry Kris S. ――Trainer. Sorry for... 
calling on you so early. There's 
something... I'd like to consult you 
about."

Even with such fluent pronunciation, I 
couldn't shake off this intense, lingering 
sense of unease—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
There's something I'd like to consult you 
about.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Merry Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yeah. This is my—"weapon" for today.

Before the confusion got completely out of 
hand, I decided to first hear out 
everything she had to say—

"To sum up the story, Symboli Kris S is 
apparently going to help out with the 
student council's 'gift distribution for 
students' this year..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...The student council planned this 
project... wishing to bring smiles to the 
students' faces. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
When delivering presents— if I go alone... 
there's a chance they might find me scary.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
So—after consulting with a few people— I 
obtained a "weapon."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If I use this greeting— —I was told 
it might soften the atmosphere... a 
little.

It certainly softens the atmosphere and 
eases the tension, but I couldn't help 
wondering who on earth suggested it to 
her...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
However, having only one "weapon" leaves 
me feeling uneasy.
choice_data_list: And that's where I come in.
So that's where I come in, huh?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Can I count on you?

I nodded and gave her a thumbs-up. Then, I 
picked up the "other weapon" she said she 
had borrowed from the student council—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――Merry Kris S. Fine. I've brought... a 
present from the Student Council.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Waah! Thank you, Kris! And that was such a 
wonderful greeting!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Merry Kris S! Hehe――"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Kris's Trainer looks wonderful too. That 
red nose and the bells on the antlers are 
so very charming♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Merry Kris S. Spe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, Kris S-san!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I've brought... a present from the student 
council.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wah, thank you so much~! Oh, I see, Kris 
S-san, you're Santa right now!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I know! I'm about to go eat the 
limited-edition Christmas Carrot Hamburg 
Steak—would you like to join me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "Thanks. But—I still have a "mission"."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Got it! Good luck with work! *Merry 
Chris-S!*

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Merry Kris S. Tannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Howah!? Kris S-san!? M-M-M-Merry 
Christmas-S-mas!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh, wait? Kris, Ma... E... Huh, huh, 
huh!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I've brought... a present from the student 
council.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh, yaaay! Thank you very much, Mr. 
Christmas!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, no! Kris S-san!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Merry Kris S. Doto.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah, Kris S-san~! Merry Christmas~.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I've brought... a present from the student 
council.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Wah, thank you so mu――――!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —That was a close call.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you so very much~~!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――Mission accomplished. Distribution to 
all students on the list――is complete.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I know it was short notice, so 
I really appreciate your help.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...So, how did it go? How did the students 
react?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone... was delighted.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Fufu— I'm glad to hear that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for coming despite your busy 
schedule, Trainer <username>. It's not much of a 
return gift, but—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I've prepared food for the Christmas 
party. Please help yourselves, if you'd 
like. I'll arrange to have it delivered to 
the trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I will gratefully accept it.
choice_data_list:
Let's have a get-together to celebrate 
today's hard work!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. —It'll double as a Christmas party, 
too.

Afterward, I gathered around the food with 
Symboli Kris S and enjoyed a modest 
Christmas party and wrap-up celebration...

Afterward, I gathered around the food with 
Symboli Kris S and enjoyed a modest 
Christmas party and wrap-up celebration—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Merry Christmas.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Showing my daily gratitude.
choice_data_list: Thank you...! Can I open it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Sure.

Inside the present was an assortment of 
body care items, including hand cream...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...Moisturizing is important. It 
affects... your condition, too."

"I try the hand cream right away. Along 
with a subtle, pleasant scent, I can 
immediately feel how thoroughly 
moisturized it is...!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Thank goodness.

—Suddenly, I notice something feels off. 
Come to think of it, just a moment ago...—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Naturally.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: You don't need that, Trainer.

—That's just the kind of person Symboli 
Kris S is. That thought made it an 
unforgettable Christmas...
